content.title: What is Soff.uz?
content.paragraph1: Soff.uz - Intellectual property marketplace, sell and buy intellectual products.
content.paragraph2: Intellectual property - the product of creative intellectual activity. Includes objects of invention and copyright, other types of creative activity in science, literature, art and production, literary, artistic, scientific works, performing arts, including sound recording, radio, television works, discoveries, inventions, rationalization proposals, industrial designs, computer programs, databases, expert systems of know-how, trademarks, company names and other intellectual property objects.
content.paragraph3: Now you can place your intellectual property through Soff Market and earn income.
